title: Denoising Surface: Modeling and Predicting Inference Cost for Diffusion LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2610.00499v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As diffusion large language models (dLLMs) become more capable, they are moving from research settings to real-world \textit{serving}, where request management (such as scheduling and resource allocation) relies on accurate estimation of per-request inference cost. However, common cost proxies fall short for dLLMs: output length ignores that one forward pass can unmask multiple tokens, and denoising-step count ignores the \textit{heterogeneous} per-step costs. We observe that the block-autoregressive generation mechanism induces a two-dimensional execution structure over output blocks and within-block denoising steps, whereas these proxies collapse it into a scalar, discarding information essential for characterizing the cost. Motivated by this insight, we propose the Denoising Workload Surface (DWS), which preserves this two-dimensional block-step structure as a probability surface to weight the heterogeneous per-step costs. translated_title: 去噪曲面：面向扩散大语言模型推理服务的推理成本建模与预测
translated_abstract: 随着扩散大语言模型能力的不断增强，它们正从研究环境走向真实世界的服务场景，在这类场景中，请求管理（如调度与资源分配）依赖于对单个请求推理成本的准确估计。然而，常用的成本代理指标对 dLLMs 并不适用：输出长度忽略了单次前向传播可以同时揭示多个 token 的事实，而去噪步数则忽略了各步骤成本的异质性。我们观察到，分块自回归生成机制在“输出块”与“块内去噪步”两个维度上诱导出一种二维执行结构，而上述代理指标将其坍缩为单一标量，丢弃了刻画成本所需的关键信息。受此启发，我们提出了去噪工作负载曲面，它将这种二维的“块—步”结构保留为一个概率曲面，用以加权异质的逐步成本。我们随后……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出去噪工作负载曲面，通过保留扩散大语言模型生成过程中“输出块×去噪步”的二维执行结构并据此加权异质的逐步成本，实现对单个请求推理成本的准确建模与预测，从而支撑服务场景中的请求调度与资源分配。
